'''2010 Worlds Day 3 Aaron Kingery DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet lists 58 Reserve Deck cards (Major Marquand and Trample struck).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Establish Secret Base]]
* '''Username:''' Archmage
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
